findings.claim: The analysis recommends provisional build/extend decisions for F4-F8 while explicitly admitting the relevant external solution categories were not surveyed.
findings.evidence: analysis.md says, "External alternatives for F4-F8 lifecycle, observability, knowledge and evaluation were not independently surveyed in this pass," while library-candidates.json still lists build_required items for F4, F5, F6, F7, and F6/F8 with rationales such as "External lifecycle alternatives were not surveyed" and "External agentic-eval alternatives were not surveyed."
findings.suggested_fix: Before Plan relies on these build_required entries, add targeted candidate evaluation for lifecycle/A2A correlation, observability/trace correlation, skill-evaluation datasets/harnesses, knowledge verification/RAG evaluation, and agentic-eval harnesses, or mark those plan areas as blocked pending follow-up research.
